limits: Questions are assistant-authored project-derived development prompts, not five independently chosen real user tasks.
Native B was prescribed to use sources; forced retrieval and fresh per-answer caches can overstate overhead versus selective personal use.
Both arms also browsed official documents. Differences in versions/sources cannot be attributed causally to MCP in one pair.
Source cutoff compliance and every peripheral assertion were not exhaustively checked.
Human preference, correction effort, actual dollar cost, reader delegation benefit and training improvement remain unknown.
